name: hindsight
description: Every new session starts knowing where your coding agents left off in this project, and Hindsight's MCP tools let Codex search and read any earlier session from any agent. Read-only; needs the Hindsight app.

interface.shortDescription: Pick up where your other coding agents left off
interface.longDescription: Hindsight indexes every coding-agent session on this machine — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and the rest. With this plugin, each new Codex session starts with where your agents left off in the project, each recent session with its last question and reply, and Codex can search and read any earlier session through Hindsight's read-only MCP tools. Needs the Hindsight app.
